answer: Cluster-Density Retro-Scoring works by logging every agent interaction into a graph, then on a rolling horizon of past epochs flagging dense subgraphs whose internal activity vastly exceeds external ties. A cluster scoring above threshold has all its accounts' accumulated rewards withheld pending review. Honest agents diversify naturally, like drift spreading across an ocean; sybils reveal themselves as tight, isolated knots. The trellis of verified links catches them because faking diverse external ties at that volume costs more than the withheld rewards,
